merge_faiss_indexes: merge multiple IVF FAISS index shard files into a single merged index
configure_merge_faiss_indexes: create a MergeFAISSIndexesConfig dataclass with indexes, lang, expected_line_count, index_type, and data fields
run_merge_module: run the MergeFAISSIndexesModule to read, merge, and write FAISS index shards sequentially
checkpoint_merge_module: checkpoint the merge process using submitit DelayedSubmission for fault-tolerant requeuing
validate_merged_index: validate the merged FAISS index total vector count matches the expected line count
